notes.title: Newest Bugfixes and Update
notes.content:
[h1]⭐ Our latest update! ⭐[/h1]

[b]Dear Super Dungeon Maker community! [/b]

this update took way longer than anticipated, but finally we we're able to release it for all of you!

[h2]⭐ What's new?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a [b]Recommended Dungeons[/b] tab to the online dungeon browser where the Dev team will add a few of their favorite player created dungeons in the future.
[*] Map now automatically focuses on player position when opening it.
[*] Added save popup when exiting the dungeon after collecting the golden egg in the editor.
[/list]

[h2]🔥 What's been fixed?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Player is now correctly shown on the map when playing a dungeon.
[*] Added Tooltips for some objects that were missing.
[*] Online Dungeons would sometimes play the wrong music.
[*] Stairs were missing in some dungeons.
[/list]

[h3]👍 What are "Recommended Dungeons"?[/h3]

The SDM team might just stumble across a fun dungeon by themselves or via the share your dungeon thread on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rokaplay]Discord[/url]. Just always try to create the most fun dungeons and it may very well be one of the newest additions to the list! The list is a wild collection of fun, long, short, puzzles, adventures and generally everything great about SDM! [b]Go check them out if you want to spend a good time![/b]

Also if you need friends to share your dungeons with, or just want to hang out with a great creative community, definitely check out our Discord server! We've got several ways to share your dungeon or recommend other fun dungeons as well!

[h3]💚 Kickstarter - A big thank you![/h3]

If you haven't checked your [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/firechick/super-dungeon-maker-play-build-and-share-your-dungeon/posts/4078201]kickstarter[/url] page for SDM lately, it's worth a trip as we share some exclusive behind the scenes infos as well.

Happy creating!

notes.content:
[h1]⭐ Fixed 1.1 Bugs - An Update! ⭐[/h1]

[b]Dear Super Dungeon Maker community! [/b]

first of all, we're sorry fixing the bugs took us a longer than expected. The timing of those bugs was quite unfortunate, but now we're ready to release the fix for the bugs that snuck into our major 1.1 update. 

**Creating and completing dungeons should now work as expected**, still we're keen on your experience and hope you wont find any of the bugs below!

[h2]🔥 What's been fixed?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Crystal Switches and Blocks (Red & Blue) would sometimes reset when walking into a new room when playing a dungeon.
[*] Triggers would not work correctly after walking too close to or through a big door.
[*] Feather dungeon was missing a door.
[*] Red-Slime would turn into green slime when stunning it using the hookshot.
[*] The Hall of Fame Area and some Dungeons where missing some tiles and objects.
[*] Reveton could be killed without bombs by stunning it first.
[/list]

Feedback is always welcome! We are looking forward to fix other bugs you submitted, but those were definitely the ones that cause the most headache. 

If you need friends to share your dungeons with, or just want to hang out with a great creative community, definitely check out our Discord server!

Happy creating!

notes.title: Update 1.1: Final Kickstarter Rewards and more!
notes.content:
[h1]⭐ Huge 1.1 Update! ⭐[/h1]

[b]Dear Super Dungeon Maker community! [/b]

We're excited to unveil the latest Update with all the Kickstarter Rewards in place - and MORE! The update is now available for everyone on [b]Steam [/b]and [b]Nintendo Switch.[/b] Dive in to see what we've got in store for you:

[h2]🔥 What's new?[/h2]
Added two new dungeon themes, each with one special unique floor tile.

[h3]Lava Theme - It's hot![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/c22728df5d886f4a6c2278d89ecb154f4437e0fd.gif[/img]
[i]What's special?[/i] Ice blocks have an additional function on the Lava theme, they transform 3 burning lava tiles into 3 walkable stone tiles! 

[h3]Tomb Theme - Skeletons beware![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/cdc2f796ac39849f2e73596a1b7cc3e67530af3a.gif[/img]
[i]What's special?[/i] Cobwebs are placed on holes, making them traversable without a feather or hook! 

[h3]New Enemies - Six times the fun![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/a9b2d959fe723da55d859af9c5c04548e89b16ac.gif[/img]
A bunch of new enemies, with new mechanics that will challenge you in a heated moment! You not only need to check your back, you'll also have your Hook, Bomb and Spin attack ready, if you want to surive the fight! 

[list]
[*] Reveton (Skeleton Chicken - Bomb him!)
[*] Projeggslime (Slime with projectiles - Attack straight on!)
[*] Sparkull (Fire Skull - They just bounce of walls?!)
[*] Hoohoo (Ghost Chicken - Spin attack!)
[*] Shieldforker (Forker with a shield - You need the Hook!)
[*] Homefly (Chasing Fly - It's chasing me!)
[/list]

[h3]New Features - Eggs, Corn, Blocks and Doors![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/e1b71cbc9c2cb818f502894b5d1d374201b2a3eb.gif[/img]
[i]What's special?[/i] The golden corn can be found throughout a dungeon. You can use them either as a form of collectible and side quest to the player, but also as a new way to block of paths or even create "vendors". The doors and blocks always use 10 corn to unlock, so place them wisely!

[list]
[*] Golden Eggs - [b]They are now placeble items! 🔥🔥 You can place multiple eggs as multiple endings on every level of the dungeon now. It's pretty epic! [/b]
[*] Gold Corn - Hide it in grass, chests or just place them on difficult to reach places!
[*] Cornblocks - Unlock a 1x1 block with 10 gold corn
[*] Corndoors - Unlock the door with 10 gold corn
[/list]

[h3]Pets - Some are Kickstarter exclusive![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/2301d9c512baab7d1ea16bb61606ca5f59661867.gif[/img]
As many of the new features, Pets were also a Kickstarter reward. You can get a pet bottom left in the town, but some pets are exclusive. They are cute and follow you around during your dungeon adventures!

[h2]A quick recap - Recent changes you might have missed![/h2]

[list]
[*] Steam Trading Cards (Steam Only): personalize your gaming profile.
[*] Added the "Hall of Fame" to the village hub
[i]You can play six dungeons created by our most dedicated Kickstarter supporters here[/i]
[*] Traps will now trigger hit and barrier switches. Use your creativity now to build some automated contraptions.
[*] Reworked the Undo-System to be more stable
[*] Replaced the fill bucket tool with a rectangle tool for tile mode
[*] We added a button that let's you instantly snap Fink towards the cursor when editing a dungeon.
[*] Builder palette no longer automatically collapses after a certain time.
[*] Added some little animations when placing objects or tiles.
[/list]

We truly hope this update is as fun for you as it is for us! Feedback is always welcome and if you need friends to share your dungeons with, or just want to hang out with a great creative community, definitely check out our Discord server!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/6e9e3fd9415bc4bb715d1e377b4b993f6da7839a.gif[/img]

[i]For all who missed the fabolous interview, here it is again, lead by a member of the Budgie Brigade 🦜 asking the important questions.[/i]

[quote=budgie]🦜: "Hello armored stranger! How did you end up here?"
[i]🛡️: "...I was once employed by a dark overlord... who made us fight a person clad in green..."[/i]

🦜: "YOU'RE EVIL?!"
[i]🛡️: "... shakes his head NO! I fled the land because everyone kept attacking feathered beings too when they could not fight back..."[/i]

🦜: "So you're one of us...!"
[i]🛡️: "... I don't want to disclose this yet... You have to earn my trust first...!"[/i]

🦜: "Well then, you're an experienced fighter, I assume?"
[i]🛡️: "...I wouldn't exactly put it this way - but I copied the moves of this rooster with the magnificent comb!"[/i]
[/quote]
We look forward to the next chapter with our brave, mysterious knight leading the charge!


[h2]Patch Details[/h2]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]

[*][b]Added a new playable character skin[/b][list]
[*]The knight stands in front of their house at the southern end of the village - Go there and interact with them to choose them as your character skin. If you want to swap back, Fink stands in front of the Egg Storage.

[list]
[*]Lost your Golden Egg or simply want to place it on a different floor - not a problem anymore

[*]Forkplants would sometimes stop their throw when backing up against a wall

[*]Spinattack would hit enemies/objects multiple times
[*][b]Bombs could not be picked up immediately after dropping them when facing north[/b]
[*][b]Crystal Switch could not be hit reliably with the hookshot from the south[/b][/*]

Also, don't forget to check out the [b]fantastic Community Dungeons[/b] the Discord Community came up with, they are huge fun and would be a [b]great challenge for the new Knight[/b]!

notes.title: Fresh Adventures Await: Dive into Our Latest Update!
notes.content:
Dear Super Dungeon Maker community,

We're excited to unveil a slew of fresh updates and enhancements for our game. The update is now available for everyone on [b]Steam [/b]and [b]Nintendo Switch.[/b] Dive in to see what we've got in store for you:

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
Added two new dungeon themes each with one unique floor tile

-[b]Hollywood or Bollywood?[/b]-
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/b28079afeb4a475312dbdd190c201a9366e2c7f9.jpg[/img]
[i]Filmset (Unique floor: A stage that will turn off all other lights and focus a spotlight on the player)[/i]

-[b]The aliens are among us[/b]-
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/f0c3a235dcd1691ac2ac8e9e5847bb037375b7ac.jpg[/img]
[i]"So Many Me" (Unique floor: A toxic mist that will deal damage when walking through or standing in it)[/i]

Added the "Hall of Fame" to the village hub
[i]You can play six dungeons created by our most dedicated Kickstarter supporters here[/i]
Replaced the fill bucket tool with a rectangle tool for tile mode
We added a button that let's you instantly snap Fink towards the cursor when editing a dungeon.

[h2]What's changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Traps will now trigger hit and barrier switches. Use your creativity now to build some automated contraptions.
[*] Reworked the Undo-System to be more stable and not result in broken rooms/objects all the time.
[*] Builder palette no longer automatically collapses after a certain time.
[*] Added automatic camera movement, when dragging an object towards the screens edge when using a gamepad.
[*] Improved Stair transition to make it less likely for players to accidentally walk back into stairs.
[*] Added some little animations when placing objects or tiles.
[*] Fixed an issue where users couldn't play online dungeons.
[/list]
[h2]Bug-Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sign in front of Fink's secret cave displayed a placeholder text.
[*] One of the birds had a placeholder text in it's speech bubble.
[*] Player Dungeons could not be correctly deleted.
[*] Player Dungeons would show up multiple times.
[*] Online Dungeons would sometimes load an empty dungeon.
[*] Room outlines would sometimes break.
[*] Massively improved the performance for dungeons with many rooms.
[*] In some cases restarting the dungeon would instead load a completely empty dungeon.
[*] Golden Egg is now visible on the map again.
[*] Collecting the flipper item multiple times would add it to the UI multiple times.
[*] Description text in the online dungeon report form could overflow the input field.
[*] Speechbubbles would stay active when switching to build mode.
[*] Game would crash when trying to show the tooltip of one of the floors in the mystic garden theme.
[/list]
[h3]Onward to 400 Reviews - We're Already at 320!🚀[/h3]
Indeed, thanks to all of you, we've already reached 320 reviews on Steam. This significant progress marks our journey towards the next big milestone: 400 reviews. While we haven't achieved our ultimate goal yet, let's take a moment to celebrate how far we've come. 🎉🥳🎈

Remember, every piece of feedback helps us to improve and grow, so thank you again for taking the time to leave a review!

notes.title: Spring Sale and Price adjustment incoming!
notes.content:
Hey Finkunity, 

We're excited to announce the start of the Spring Sale on Steam and wanted to let you know about a great deal on Super Dungeon Maker! This is your last chance to grab a copy at the early access price and save some cash before we have to adjust the price.

[h3][b]After the Spring Sale, the final price for Super Dungeon Maker will be $19.99/€. By purchasing now, you can save 40% compared to the new price.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Why a price adjustment?[/b][/h3]
Firstly, we need to plan for the release of the Nintendo eShop pre-order page, and we're required to show the final price of $19.99/€ on this page. Therefore, we need to adjust the price on Steam accordingly.

Another main reason for the price adjustment is to ensure that the price matches the content that has already been released as well as the content that's planned for future releases. We communicated this to our community when we first started the early access phase, and although we knew that a price adjustment was inevitable, we aimed to remain within the price segment of indie games.

Inflation is another factor that has influenced our pricing decisions for Super Dungeon Maker. We've taken into account the increasing costs of production and distribution, as well as other product costs such as manpower, marketing, and developers' fees when making our pricing decisions.

[h3][b]Will there be more content? [/b][/h3]
Absolutely! We'll continue to expand the game's content based on user and community feedback, and we'll be communicating our roadmap for upcoming phases soon.

The final price of Super Dungeon Maker on both Steam and the Nintendo eShop will be $19.99/€. And, to give you a full overview, we've also prepared a summary of all the progress we've made during the past year of early access.

Thanks for your support and happy gaming!

[h3][b]Here is the changelog summary for the last 12 months:[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]What's new?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new languages to the game: Korean, Japanese, and traditional Chinese.
[*] Added logos for Chinese and Japanese to the start screen.
[*] The detail view of online dungeons now shows the builder's selected tags.
[*] Players can download online dungeons and play them later from the Storage Room.
[*] Added the ability to apply up to two tag filters when searching for dungeons to play.
[*] Added the ability for builders to add up to two tags for each dungeon, making it easier for players to find dungeons they like.
[*] Added a new enemy: the Stingtoise.
[*] Added an ice/snow theme, along with a frozen push block and new decorative objects for each dungeon setting.
[*] Added tooltips and detailed explanations for most objects in the game.
[*] Added a lock block that can be opened with a key.
[*] Added a pop-up effect when collecting an item from a treasure chest.
[*] Added a map icon to the UI, which shows the layout of the current room.
[*] Updated the Dungeon Browser and Dungeon Builder UI for better usability.
[*] Implemented a map item that shows the layout of the entire dungeon and unvisited rooms.
[*] Added a compass collectible that shows the location of treasure chests, doors/stairs, and the golden egg.
[*] Added two new bosses: Power Plant and Grubtus.
[*] Added a report button for online dungeons in the pause menu.
[*] Added a boss that builders can use in their dungeons: Wormion.
[*] Added a despawner that allows objects to be despawned based on a trigger channel.
[*] Added more floor alternatives and decoration elements.
[*] Added three new types of triggers: Hit-Trigger, Pull-Trigger, and Invisible Trigger.
[*] Added a Spawner object that spawns objects based on a trigger channel.
[*] Improved door placement, allowing closed doors to be directly placed or clicked into.
[*] Added an hourglass button that allows players to reset the current room during online play.
[/list]

[h3][b]What Changed:[/b][/h3]

[*] Adjusted Start screen text and visuals

[*] Map Texture was too small.
[*] The header bar in the "My Dungeons" Screen had the wrong size on none standard resolutions.
[*] Map key was inconsistent for different keyboard layouts. Should now always be the "M" key.
[*] Map Tiles can have weird artifacts on some resolutions (partially fixed).
[*] Uploading/Removing Online Dungeons was not working.
[*] Invisible Triggers were triggered by movable blocks.

[/list]

notes.title: New Enemy - Stingtoise
notes.content:
Hey Fink´s friends,

We had our spring cleaning last week and I want to tell you about it. But also about new content and what has changed. Well then, let's get started.

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
Added a new enemy the Stingtoise - It has a strong spikey shell, but a soft bottom -  You need to flip it, by blocking with your shield, before hitting it.
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The dungeon entrance door now closes after Fink enters - No more accidentally walking out of the dungeon and losing all your progress.
[*] Added Ctrl as alternative Input for shield.
[/list]
[h3]Bug-Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The dungeon entrance door was visible even when fink was in another room.
[*] Pushable Blocks had the forest visuals in all dungeon themes, making them trivial to identify.
[*] Flying Tiles would not work correctly on floors other than F1
[*] Objects would not show on the map when playing a Dungeon in play-only mode
[*] Stairs would not show on the map at all
[*] Fixed a few typos in English texts.
[*]
Doorways could be randomly stuck into and next to each other creating unwalkable tiles and broken walls - Sorry Xzibit
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/0c27abd7c44318a1bf8ba3e59e613ae81d3beb19.png[/img]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doorways may still break when using the Undo and Redo function (especially when using it multiple times)
[*] Doorways that already exist when loading the dungeon may still break.
[/list]
[h3]What else is happening[/h3]
We get a lot of feedback from the community and also a lot of bugs reported. Thanks also to all who help us so much. We give ourselves a lot of effort. Of course we would like to implement every idea as far as possible, but we have to prioritize. Here is a small sample from our Tasktracker Asana.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/524d070eb6f99838fe62579d4c07efe04534a128.jpg[/img]
As you can see it looks quite colorful. We give each bug or feedback a value. This value is from the user's point of view - how valuable is this point for the player. After that, we evaluate how much effort is required. A 1 = Yoyo is not that much effort. A 5 = Walkman, costs quite a bit of effort. In addition, how acute is the bug. A - Critical and would have to be fixed promptly. This helps us decide what to do next.

Next week, maybe I'll tell you about the things that are so important to you players right now.

[h3]PS: I have decided to announce a new community goal. By the end of February I want to celebrate 200 reviews on steam with you 🎉. That would be so incredible if we could achieve that. I count on every single one. ❤️❤️❤️[/h3]

Please also let us know what you would like to know about the internal development. I'll see what impressions I can share there.

notes.title: This is what has happened in the last 3 months.
notes.content:
Hey Fink´s friends,

We haven't posted any progress updates for a while, although we continued to update the game. The focus in development hasn't changed, but the marketing team has been busy with the Kickstarter. Therefore, a summary from September 14, 2022. A lot of it you've probably already found on your own, but I just didn't want to forget anything. (And yet it will happen).

[b][i]There is a small spoiler section at the end of the news. You have been warned with it.[/i][/b]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a map icon to the UI to show if the map was selected and which key/button to press to open it
[*] The compass will now play a sound cue when entering a room that contains a key.
[*] Added a small pop up effect when collecting an item that shows you what you collected. You can finally see which item you got from a treasure chest.
[*] We added [b]tooltips[/b] for most objects that you can build into your dungeon.
[*] Some objects offer more detailed explanations with the press of a button.
[*] We added a[b] lock block[/b] - Use a key to open the lock and destroy the block.
[*] Save game notification. After 5 minutes without saving you will get a discreet info. Do you like the solution?
[/list]
[h3]What's changed?[/h3]
[list]
[*] The compass will now play a sound cue when entering a room that contains a key.
[*] We improved the menu controls for gamepad users - consistent navigation and better audio feedback for your actions.
[*] Various minor updates to the User Interface.
[/list]
[h3]Bug-Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Map Texture was too small.
[*] The compass did not correctly show icons on different floors.
[*] Keys and Map Display would overlap.
[*] Enemies would incorrectly affect events (doors/spawners) in other rooms.
[*] Seasonal themes did not work correctly for dungeons uploaded during the event.
[*] Spawners on the enemy channel would not work correctly.
[*]The game may sometimes crash while closing the application - "YOU CAN'T FIRE ME! I QUIT!!!"
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Downloading dungeons takes a long time - Currently looking into this

[/list]

[h3]What's on our minds and what we're sitting on right now.[/h3]
Of course we have been busy with Kickstarter lately, but Flonja and Adrian have been the main ones. Unfortunately, no "Updates News" came and we also heard you loudly that it is important to you. We will stay tuned, but we ask for your patience and understanding. We don't want to upset anyone with this, we ultimately want it to be a fantastic project. We are currently still sitting on a new theme. For this, Linda created beautiful pixelart graphics and Julian is hacking in Unity3D. At the same time we get a lot of feedback and change requests. We still have to sort it all out, but we appreciate your feedback. 

I hope I could give you a good insight. We are looking forward to your feedback.
